Email communication plan

Which emails will be sent?

Eight planned email categories after backend and email-service integration.

01 · COMPANY
Registration confirmation

Confirms the company's registration request.

02 · COMPANY
Payment instructions / receipt

Shares payment details and confirmation after verification.

03 · COMPANY ADMIN
Access code issued

Sends activation details after onboarding.

04 · COMPANY ADMIN
QR code ready

Confirms that the company QR is ready to download.

05 · EMPLOYEE
Complaint reference confirmation

Optional confirmation with reference number, without case details.

06 · AUTHORIZED IC
New complaint alert

Generic alert asking authorized recipients to sign in and review.

07 · COMPANY ADMIN
Renewal reminder

Reminder before subscription renewal date.

08 · SECURITY
Account security alert

Password reset, access changes and suspicious sign-in notices.

Complaint details and attachments must not be included in ordinary notification emails.

Privacy and data security

How will company and complaint data be protected?

Production security will use multiple layers. These are planned controls, not claims that this current landing page stores or protects live complaint data.

Planned protection layers

  • Company-wise data separation
  • Role-based access for authorized IC users
  • HTTPS in transit and encryption at rest
  • Private storage for evidence files
  • Multi-factor authentication for privileged accounts
  • Audit logs for viewing, changes and downloads
  • Encrypted backups and retention controls
  • Security testing and incident response

FAQs

Important things to know

Can we pay directly on this website now?

No. Online payment is not integrated yet. It will show Coming Soon. Contact the developer for payment instructions.

Is POSH Portal government approved?

No government approval or endorsement is claimed. It is a private software service by AGKENTECH.

Does subscribing make our company POSH-compliant?

No. The employer and statutory committees retain their legal responsibilities.

Where will complaints be accessed?

In a separate secure complaint dashboard by authorized committee members.
